create_DINOHead: create a DINOHead module with specified input dimension, output dimension, and bottleneck dimension
build_mlp_network: build an MLP network with configurable layers, hidden dimensions, batch normalization, and GELU activations
initialize_DINOHead_weights: initialize DINOHead weights using trunc_normal distribution with zero-initialized biases
normalize_and_project_features: normalize feature vectors with L2 normalization and project through weight-normed linear layer
configure_DINOHead_MLP: configure DINOHead MLP with custom number of layers, hidden dimension, batch normalization, and bias settings
